name: KadevPay

spans: En utilisant nos services, le Marchand accepte également les conditions générales d'utilisation de Paystack.
Retard dans les délais de reversement imputable aux institutions bancaires ou aux vérifications de conformité (KYC) de l'agrégateur.

open_questions: The Starter account needs only an ID and caps collections at 200 000 FCFA a month; the Business account, without a cap, requires company documents (RCCM, DFE).

KadevPay's terms say payments go through Paystack, whose terms the merchant also accepts, and mention 'vérifications de conformité (KYC) de l'agrégateur': whether Paystack's own KYC applies on top of KadevPay's is not said.
KadevPay's pages do not say whether a Starter account gets live API keys.

description: KadevPay is an Ivorian payment gateway supporting mobile money (Orange Money, MTN MoMo) and card payments via a client-side JavaScript SDK.
example_prompt: Add KadevPay checkout to my app to accept mobile money and card payments in Côte d'Ivoire.
